user.description: The user to run the environment as.

install.description: The install script to run on VM startup (after pulling latest changes) to refresh dependencies.

start.description: The start command to run when the environment is started.

repositoryDependencies.description: Repositories that are required for the environment to work, and need to be included in the GitHub access token that is generated for the environment.

items.description: The URL of the dependent repository, e.g. `github.com/org/repo`.

disableAllMcpServers.description: When true, block every user and team MCP server for agents using this environment. Cursor built-in MCP servers are never restricted. An empty mcpServerAllowlist alone does not disable MCP.

mcpServerAllowlist.description: MCP server identities allowed by this environment when disableAllMcpServers is false. Omit or leave empty (with disableAllMcpServers false/omitted) to inherit upstream team/user MCP policy.

items.description: Allow an HTTP MCP by serverUrl pattern, or a stdio MCP by command pattern.

name.description: Display name for the MCP server.

serverUrl.description: Allowed HTTP MCP server URL or domain pattern.

toolAllowlist.description: Tool names exposed by this MCP server. Omit or leave empty to allow all tools.

egressAllowlist.description: Additional outbound domains that agents in this environment are allowed to reach. When set without egressMode, it is unioned with the inherited user/team network allowlist.

egressMode.description: How this environment's egress allowlist combines with team/user network settings. `allow_all` disables egress restrictions (subject to team policy). `parent_plus_network_settings` unions egressAllowlist with the inherited user/team allowlist. `default_with_network_settings` allows the default domains plus egressAllowlist. `network_settings_only` allows only required domains plus egressAllowlist.

chromeExecutablePath.description: Path to a Chrome/Chromium executable inside the environment, used for browser-based testing.

enable_testing.description: Whether agents may run cloud testing (e.g. computer use) in this environment. Defaults to true; set to false to disable.

ports.description: Ports to expose from the container. Similar to devcontainers port forwarding.

name.description: A descriptive name for the port (e.g., 'web server', 'api').

port.description: The port number inside the container to expose.

terminals.description: The terminals to run when the environment is started.

command.description: The command to run in the terminal.

description.description: A description of what the terminal does. This is displayed to the agent.

command.description: The command to run in the terminal.

description.description: A description of what the terminal does. This is displayed to the agent.

dockerfile.description: The location of the Dockerfile that defines the contents of the container. The path is relative to the folder containing the `environment.json` file.

dockerfileContents.description: Inline Dockerfile content. Use this instead of `dockerfile` when you want to define the Dockerfile directly in `environment.json`.

context.description: The location of the context folder for building the Docker image. The path is relative to the folder containing the `environment.json` file.

image.description: An explicit container image reference (registry image) for the environment base. One of `build`, `image`, or `snapshot` typically defines the environment base.

snapshot.description: A snapshot ID for the base environment. Takes precedence over `build` and `image` when set.

agentCanUpdateSnapshot.description: Whether the agent can update the snapshot. Defaults to true for snapshot-based and default-base environments; always false when the base is `build` or `image`.
